title: The dry run stopped
body: The checks an install starts with did not pass (phone: images/vendor_kernel_boot.img is 12288 bytes, larger than vendor_kernel_boot_b (8192 bytes)).
If this looks wrong for your phone, tell us at https://github.com/derekross/omarchy-mobile/issues
footer: The installer only asked the phone what it is. It has written nothing to it.
Starting the installer again as things are will stop here again.
